lines.en: I show up at the Chosokabe house sometime in the afternoon to find Chinami decked out in her winter gear.
lines.zh: 下午我去了 Chosokabe 家，发现 Chinami 全副冬装打扮。

lines.en: I ask her if she plans on going anywhere and she reminds me that she isn't allowed to leave the house or she'll have her phone taken away.
lines.zh: 我问她是不是要出门，她提醒我她不能离开屋子，否则手机会被没收。

lines.en: As it turns out, she just wanted to wear her winter clothes so she could pretend she was going outside and building a snowman.
lines.zh: 原来她只是想穿上冬装，假装自己要出去堆雪人。

lines.en: This tragic happening sparks a struggle within me about whether I want to risk her life for her happiness and...
lines.zh: 这件惨事在我心里掀起一场挣扎——要不要拿她的命去换她的开心，然后……

lines.en: Well, I decide to not risk killing anyone today.
lines.zh: 好吧，我决定今天不拿人命冒险。

lines.en: Besides, I'm pretty sure I'd be in a lot of trouble as well if Chika found out that I even considered bringing her outdoors in this weather.
lines.zh: 再说了，要是 Chika 知道我动过在这种天气把她带到户外的念头，我肯定也得吃不了兜着走。

lines.en: Chinami comes up with the brilliant idea to play pretend-snowman with me- which basically involves me standing straight up and...
lines.zh: Chinami 想出个绝妙主意：跟我玩「假装雪人」——基本就是我站直了，然后……

lines.en: Well, pretending to be a snowman.
She walks in circles around me for half an hour, patting me up and down as if I were actually made of snow-
lines.zh: 她绕着我转了半小时的圈，上上下下拍我，好像我真是一堆雪做的——

lines.en: And I can't help but think about turning this into a horror movie and coming to life to chase her around the house.
lines.zh: 而我忍不住想把这变成恐怖片，活过来满屋子追她。

lines.en: But that, too, sounds like way too much trouble.
lines.zh: 不过那听起来也太麻烦了。

lines.en: So I just let her keep going until she wants to take a nap and then leave the house in search of something else to do.
lines.zh: 所以我就由着她继续，直到她想睡午觉，然后我就出门找别的事干了。
Chinami 的好感度提升到了 [chinami_love]！
